name: TCM knowledge semantic crosswalk to Toledo/Genesis/BIRCA (not predictive)

statement.latest: Traditional Chinese medical terms, patterns, channel and point identifiers may be preserved as sourced, typed knowledge records and mapped to Toledo readout concepts and separately to PubMed study metadata. The mapping describes HOW Toledo/BIRCA reads TCM, not WHAT will happen to a person's health. No Qi diagnosis, biomarker forecast, acupuncture efficacy, step-to-clock correspondence or CAN-006 weld is asserted.
statement.note_ascii: NEW NONCANONICAL RESEARCH PROPOSAL: semantic translation/indexing only; point–protocol–assay associations are optional metadata, not a biological dynamical equation. Follow-up qihua_transformation_10_case_followup is noncanonical, no new root dynamics, no predictive performance.

claim_boundary: Purpose is semantic readout of Chinese-medicine knowledge and cross-links to existing Toledo and BIRCA schemas. No self-prediction or other-person prediction, no qi blockage diagnosis, no proven causal mapping, no health/sexual personality forecast and no treatment inference; only explicitly sourced PubMed studies as contextual evidence. CAN-006 and B.29/B.30 HOLD.

readout_scope.genesis_life: external conceptual annotation, not canonical Toledo equation

translation_rules.zang_fu_vs_anatomy: Traditional Liver/Kidney/Spleen are source-specific functional zang-fu concepts; do not collapse with anatomical organs
translation_rules.qi_vs_biophysics: Qi or meridian label has no licensed conversion into energy, nerve, vascular or biochemical signal
translation_rules.point_code_vs_position: 361 point-code inventory does not certify precise anatomical atlas positions
translation_rules.point_vs_effect: point mention in a multi-point intervention does not isolate an individual point effect
translation_rules.graph_edge: semantic attributed edge is not a demonstrated causal or anatomic pathway
translation_rules.clock_vs_step: clinical observation time not native Toledo step
translation_rules.missing_data: unmeasured/uncertain information remains null or HOLD, never predicted or zero-filled
